controls.name: Institution-specific charter adoption
controls.gate: Require signed participant charter and participation agreement; unknown means no rail entitlement

controls.name: BEAC initiated debit detection
controls.gate: Treat a verified central-bank debit as an external financial fact requiring controlled Accounting Core posting and independent reconciliation; never simulate debit

controls.name: Restitution/finality separation
controls.gate: Maintain original settlement immutable; any return or forced debit is a distinct externally evidenced movement
controls.source: BEAC charter Art 56; 2023 circular applicability pending

controls.name: Dual-supervisor incident routing
controls.gate: Classify BEAC payment-system incidents separately from COBAC ICT incidents; distinct evidence, deadlines, receipts and obligations
controls.source: BEAC RSF 2024 p41; COBAC R-2024/01 Art 30 pending

controls.name: SANGHA authority
controls.gate: Reporting adapter disabled without issuer-approved access, schemas, credentials and institution role

controls.name: Change notification
controls.gate: Material participant platform change triggers evidence-backed BEAC notification and controlled release workflow

controls.name: Admin segregation
controls.gate: Technical and functional administrators distinct; enforced server-side, cross-tenant scoped

controls.name: Daily rail data processing
controls.gate: Daily reconciliation must identify missing/excess/duplicate/unmatched external movements

controls.name: Historical routing quarantine
controls.gate: 2014 threshold/exception cannot activate modern routing without current rules and agreement

controls.name: Retention ownership
controls.gate: Separate BEAC archival undertaking from bank-specific retention obligations; no automatic ten-year bank-wide retention

controls.name: Signed instruction quarantine
controls.gate: 001/GR/2024 cannot generate exact authentication/PIN requirements until operative text and amendments authenticated

controls.name: Liquidity and operational continuity
controls.gate: Prove participant continuity, operational cash forecasting, intraday liquidity and failover without fabricated BEAC credit

controls.name: Legal provenance conflict
controls.gate: Track 2013/2014 preamble mismatch; do not use a guessed surveillance-instruction identity

controls.name: GIMAC dispute authority
controls.gate: Do not claim GIMAC DISPUTES onboarding or access from public launch report

ExternalSettlementMovement.rule: never create a settlement fact from local status changes

RestitutionCase.rule: external debit not inferred from request or notice; duplicate posting prohibited

SupervisorIncidentCase.rule: two separate reporting obligations may coexist; never infer delivery from local enqueue

ReportingReceipt.rule: unknown outcome must remain unresolved pending issuer receipt

LegalInstrumentVersion.rule: no auto activation from explanatory report
